name: Dazzling Brilliance
body:
School evocation [light]; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You unleash a brilliant flash of light in the area that dazzles those within for 1 minute. A successful Fortitude save negates the dazzling, but if they fail the save by 5 or more they are blinded for 1 round then dazzled for 1 minute. Sightless creatures are not affected by this spell. This spell also counters and dispels a darkness spell of equal level or lower.
